title: Update TrainPipelineStep to read parquet files from coordinator output
description: TrainPipelineStep currently expects train.gz/test.gz pickle files from SplitDatasetPipelineStep. After the parallel K8s processing refactor, FEATURE_ENGINEER outputs .parquet files registered as ClearML Dataset external files. TRAIN needs to: 1) Download external .parquet files via get_mutable_local_copy(), 2) Concatenate them into a single DataFrame, 3) Update _get_data() to read .parquet instead of pickle.

title: Fix Plotter NameError in plotting_pipeline_step.py
description: plotting_pipeline_step.py line 77 references 'Plotter' which is not imported or defined anywhere in the template tree. This would raise NameError at runtime when _create_plot() is called. The class either needs to be imported from its visualization module or the step needs to be updated to use the correct class name.
